headline: Bajaj Electricals submits SEBI depository compliance certificate
hook: Routine compliance filing from Bajaj Electricals
summary: Bajaj Electricals Limited has submitted a regulatory certificate to the stock exchange under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018. This is a routine procedural filing required for listed companies. It has no direct impact on the company's financial performance or stock price. Indian retail investors do not need to take any action based on this disclosure.

headline: Bajaj Electricals receives ₹29.63 lakh GST relief for FY18
hook: Minor tax relief for Bajaj Electricals
summary: Bajaj Electricals has received a GST relief order amounting to ₹29.63 lakh for the 2017-18 financial year. The relief follows a tax assessment review for that period. This adjustment is a routine procedural outcome regarding historical tax liabilities.
why_it_matters: Negligible impact on company financials or shareholder value.
